title: SourceRecord
description: A governed content source. Nothing reaches a student unless a SourceRecord for it is 'approved', carries a deliverable license, and names its authority and review date. See docs/content-governance.md.

uri.description: Where the source lives, if online.

tier.description: Source tier, strongest first. 'standards' defines objectives; 'pedagogy' informs technique; neither is student-facing content.

authorityType.description: Who produced the source — a proxy for credibility.

license.description: Usage rights. Student-facing content must not be 'all_rights_reserved'.

reviewStatus.description: Only 'approved' sources may be cited by a published objective.

reviewBy.description: Date the source must be re-reviewed by.
